note: Resolved findings for the React + MUI port. The vanilla prototype has its own log at projects/q-explorer-prototype/findings-log.json; findings resolved there are not automatically resolved here.

resolved.what: no login screen at all in the port
resolved.fix: Login component ported, gated app, per-field errors; suite signs in and asserts the screen before dismissing it
verified_by: verify-qx-react.cjs: 'the app opens on a login screen', 'an empty submit errors both fields separately', 'a filled submit signs in'

resolved.what: preview+delete on every row regardless of status or type
resolved.fix: row actions extracted per row from the vanilla markup; preview only on done rows, download on raw_data, none on line_analysis
verified_by: verify-qx-react.cjs: 'every row offers exactly the actions the vanilla gives it' — compares each row against EVALUATIONS[].actions
proved by reintroducing the bug (3 failures with, 0 without)

resolved.what: period filter was state nothing read - it filtered nothing
resolved.fix: period clause added, the vanilla's five options, Clear filters, live count, search clear
verified_by: verify-qx-react.cjs: 'the period filter actually filters' — row count vs EVALUATIONS filtered by periodKey
proved by deleting the clause (fails)

resolved.what: row name was a link, opening reports for failed rows that have none
resolved.fix: plain text, as in the vanilla; the report is reached by the preview action
verified_by: verify-qx-react.cjs: row-action comparison (no 'view' button on failed rows)
qx-feature-parity.cjs reports 0 gaps on reports-list

resolved.fix: confirm dialog then undo snackbar, matching cfAsk + showUndoToast
verified_by: verify-qx-react.cjs: 'delete opens a confirmation rather than deleting', 'confirming removes the row', 'an undo toast is offered', 'undo puts the row back'

resolved.what: three hand-typed schedules against the vanilla's six, wrong columns, one filter of three
resolved.fix: schedules extracted; vanilla columns incl. Last run; search/frequency/status filters; pause/resume
verified_by: verify-qx-react.cjs: 'every schedule is listed, from the extracted data' (6), 'the schedule table carries a Last run column', status filter, search empty state, pause/resume flip

resolved.what: login page invented rather than ported - no wordmark, blue button, footer instead of utility bar
resolved.fix: rebuilt to measured geometry; logo extracted; 6 geometry assertions
verified_by: verify-qx-react.cjs: six geometry assertions (card 380/36-40 padding, flag 56x62, wordmark 210x61, navy 39px button, forgot link, utility bar pinned bottom) read off the vanilla

resolved.what: evaluation type sections were static headings, not accordions
resolved.fix: clickable header, rotating chevron, aria-expanded, collapsing table, keyboard operable
verified_by: verify-qx-react.cjs: 'clicking a group header collapses its table', 'the collapsed header says so', 'the header itself stays visible and clickable when collapsed'
proved by forcing the group open (fails)

resolved.what: top bar scrolled away; the vanilla's #topbar is position:fixed
resolved.fix: AppBar position fixed below the banner with the matching 48px offset
verified_by: verify-qx-react.cjs: 'the top bar is fixed', 'the top bar stays put when the page scrolls'
qx-feature-parity.cjs shell probe compares position against the vanilla
proved by reverting to position:static (fails)

resolved.what: Connection report had no parameter chips
resolved.fix: three read-only chips extracted from the vanilla, each expanding to its membership list with the read-only footer
verified_by: verify-qx-react.cjs: 'the Connection report carries its parameter chips' (3, equals CONNECTION_CHIPS.length), 'a chip expands into its membership list', 'the expanded chip reports its state'

resolved.what: punctuality report opened one breakdown level deep instead of two
resolved.fix: default dims match the vanilla's selected=linienbuendel/linie
verified_by: verify-qx-react.cjs: 'the report opens two levels deep, as the vanilla does', 'clearing the second level collapses the tree back'

resolved.what: failed rows had no failure reason and no Run again — the vanilla injects both in annotateFailedRows()
resolved.fix: reason printed under the name and on the status chip as a tooltip; Run again restores the row to In Progress and clears both, as retryEvaluation() does
verified_by: verify-qx-react.cjs: 'a failed row prints its failure reason'
'a failed row offers Run again'
'Run again moves the row to In Progress'
'the failure reason goes away once it is rerunning'

resolved.what: every action stayed live on a still-running evaluation — the port let you delete a running job; the vanilla disables them in markUnavailableActions()
resolved.fix: all actions disabled with aria-disabled and the 'not available while running' reason on hover
verified_by: verify-qx-react.cjs: 'every action on a still-running evaluation is disabled'
'and its remaining actions go dead while it runs'

resolved.what: column headers were not sortable; the vanilla wires initSortableHeaders()/sortByColumn()
resolved.fix: TableSortLabel on Name/Period/Created/Status, ascending then descending, with the active indicator
verified_by: verify-qx-react.cjs: 'column headers sort the rows'
'the sorted column shows its direction'

resolved.what: both filter dropdowns reported an EMPTY accessible name — visually labelled, unnamed to a screen reader
resolved.fix: InputLabel id + Select labelId wired in the shared FilterSelect, so all of them gain it at once
verified_by: verify-qx-react.cjs: 'both filter dropdowns have a real accessible name'

resolved.what: row action buttons were named only by verb (view/delete/download) with no row identity
resolved.fix: aria-label carries the action and the evaluation name; a separate data-act attribute is the hook the checkers select on
verified_by: verify-qx-react.cjs: 'a row action names the evaluation it acts on, not just its verb'
row-action comparison now selects on data-act
